channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: A patronising bishop out of touch with reality
item.description: The Gozo Bishop's words were an attempt to guilt-trip parents, especially women, who already find it hard to leave their children in child care, while they are constrained to return to the workplace after 18 weeks of maternity leave

item.title: WATCH | Jason Deguara: ‘Chaos and individuality reign when solidarity is absent’
item.description: The incoming president of the General Workers’ Union, Jason Deguara, believes solidarity among workers is weakening. In his first interview since being elected to the post, he tells Matthew Farrugia the biggest challenges the union faces concern employment conditions of migrant workers and the unstable geopolitical situation

item.title: When the shelves emptied, the system spoke
item.description: If Malta genuinely cares about wellbeing, resilience and long-term stability, then agriculture cannot remain peripheral. Its foundations must become a national priority

item.title: Police arrest 20-year-old man in Santa Venera drug trafficking operation
item.description: The man was arrested in Santa Venera after allegedly suspicious activity

item.title: I do know Jeffrey, and I like him: US ambassador to Malta named in Epstein files
item.description: United States ambassador to Malta, who last week said she will not hesitate to forward Trump's agenda in her newly appointed role, is mentioned in freshly released documents relating to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein

item.title: Government will table Bill to regulate use of internet deepfakes: Robert Abela
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela says while he does not agree with outright ban of social media, regulating its use is crucial in protecting young generation

item.title: Alex Borg doubles down: ‘Discussions on new chief justice must remain confidential’
item.description: In an interview with MaltaToday Executive Editor Kurt Sansone, Opposition leader Alex Borg slams Robert Abela for invoking neutrality according to political gain, voicing doubts on Malta joining Trump peace board

item.title: Momentum calls for illegal establishments to be excluded from Storm Harry compensation scheme
item.description: The party says taxpayer money must not be used to reward businesses that unlawfully occupied public land

item.title: Delia calls for action after son was assaulted by gang in Sliema
item.description: PN MP Adrian Delia says repeated gang violence points to growing safety problem for families
